{{Short description|Australian chemist and academic}}
{{Use dmy dates|date=November 2019}}
{{Use Australian English|date=November 2019}}
'''Ronald Drayton Brown''' {{post-nominals|list=AM FAA}} (14 October 1927 – 2 November 2008) was an Australian chemist and academic.

In 1959, he was appointed to the Foundation Chair of Chemistry at [[Monash University]], where he remained head of the department until 1992.

He was then elected a [[Fellow of the Australian Academy of Science]] in 1965 and appointed as a [[Member of the Order of Australia]] in 2002.<ref name="AAS">{{cite journal |author1= Peter D.
